_comment: Hard crowd control the ability TEXT cannot support, one way or the other.
web/advisor/hardcc.py reads the effect out of the tooltip, which is the
right source: it survives a re-scrape and it does not need a human to
keep 141 champions in their head. What it cannot do is read text that is
not there. Three tooltips in the scrape are truncated mid-sentence, and
all three are truncated exactly where the crowd control was:
Diana     Moonfall's text ends at 'slowing targets by 20%' and never
reaches the drag that is the whole point of the ultimate.
Jhin      Deadly Flourish ends at 'If the t' -- the root is the rest
Shyvana   Dragon's Descent ends at 'Active' before the knockback.
These are corrections to the SOURCE, not tuning. Each names the ability
so it stays checkable, and each should be deleted the day the scrape
carries the full tooltip -- run scripts/audit_hard_cc.py to find out.
'remove' is for the opposite case and is deliberately empty: the deriver
currently has no false positives on the labelled set, and an entry here
should be justified by a specific tooltip, not by a hunch about a kit.
